test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The waiters were quick to__ replenish __their stock of food.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Fill up**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Replenish**" means to refill or resupply. (फिर से भरना)
 
• The phrasal verb "**fill up**" means to become completely full; to make something completely full. (किसी चीज़ को पूरी तरह से पूर्ण बनाना)
 
• "Fill up" is a suitable synonym for "replenish"
